name: PFD AI Quick Read Summarizer – Fast Article TL;DR, Key Takeaways & Post Summaries
author: paidfreedroid

sections.description:
PFD AI Quick Read Summarizer adds a sleek, modern, interactive “Show Quick Read” (TL;DR) key takeaways box to the top of your articles and pages. With one click, your visitors get a concise, high-impact bulleted summary synthesized instantly using Google’s fast Gemini AI model.

In today’s fast-paced digital world, readers have short attention spans. Providing an immediate executive summary hooks visitors, lowers your bounce rate, and encourages them to stay on your page longer to explore the full article.

Why Every WordPress Site Needs an AI Quick Read Box

  • Boost Time on Site & Dwell Time: Readers who scan key takeaways first are 40% more likely to read the full article instead of bouncing back to search results.
  • SEO & Google Snippet Friendly: Deliver dense, structured information gain that search engines and AI search engines love.
  • Smart Zero-Latency Caching: Summaries are generated once and saved directly in your database. Subsequent visitors experience zero wait time and zero repeat API costs!
  • Works with Aggressive Page Caching: Fully compatible with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Cloudflare, and browser cache.
  • Auto Adaptive Design: Effortlessly blends into light themes, dark themes, or minimal publication styles.

Core Features

  • ⚡ One-Click Summaries: Automatically condenses any post or page into 2-3, 3-5, or 5-7 bullet points.
  • 🤖 Powered by Google Gemini AI: Choose between Gemini 2.5 Flash (recommended for blistering speed) or Gemini 2.5 Pro (for in-depth analytical reasoning).
  • 🎨 5 Modern Design Themes: Choose between Auto-Adaptive (theme-responsive), PFD Original Classic (#1A1A1A Obsidian & Neon Gradient Border), Light Card, Dark Obsidian, or Minimalist Inset.
  • 🎯 Flexible Display Placement: Place automatically above post content, after the first paragraph, or manually via shortcode.
  • 🧩 Shortcode & Block Builder Support: Embed anywhere using [pfd_quick_read] or [pfd_ai_summarizer].
  • ✍️ Post Editor Sidebar Controls: Clear cache or force-regenerate summaries directly from the WordPress post editor sidebar.
  • ⚙️ Pre-Generate on Publish: Automatically generate summaries when publishing new posts so readers and search bots get them instantly.
  • 🔒 Privacy & Wallet Protection: Built-in rate limiting and secure database storage to prevent API spam.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pfd-ai-quick-read-summarizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > PFD AI Summarizer.
  4. Paste your free Google Gemini API Key (get a free key at Google AI Studio).
  5. Choose your preferred theme style and placement, then click Save Settings.
  6. That’s it! Your articles will now display the interactive Quick Read summary button.
sections.faq:
Is the Google Gemini API key free?

Yes! Google provides a generous free tier for Gemini that allows thousands of API requests per month at zero cost.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is engineered for maximum performance. It enqueues minimal, vanilla-optimized CSS and JS. Furthermore, summaries are cached directly in your database as post metadata, so the AI API is only called once per post.

Does it work with caching plugins like WP Rocket or LiteSpeed?

Yes. Version 1.1.0 includes cache-aware AJAX handling. When a summary is already cached in post meta, it serves immediately without failing on expired security nonces.

Can I choose which post types display the summary?

Yes. Go to Settings > PFD AI Summarizer and toggle support for Posts, Pages, or custom post types.

Can I manually insert the summary box anywhere?

Yes! Simply use the shortcode [pfd_quick_read] in any Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, or page template.

Does this plugin share my personal data?

No. Only the public title and text of the article being summarized are sent to the Google Gemini API. No user data, passwords, or visitor information is ever transmitted.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4

  • NEW: Added the original signature “PFD Original Classic” theme (#1A1A1A Obsidian with purple-to-cyan neon gradient border and glowing bullet points) back to the Card Theme presets.
  • TWEAK: Universal dynamic luminance detection engine for seamless automatic dark/light mode compatibility across all WordPress themes.
  • ASSETS: Added authentic high-resolution Chromium browser screenshots.

1.1.0

  • NEW: Added 4 customizable card themes: Auto-Adaptive, Light Card, Dark Obsidian, and Minimalist Inset.
  • NEW: Added custom Accent Color picker in admin settings.
  • NEW: Added Model Selector supporting Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and custom endpoints.
  • NEW: Added summary length control (2-3, 3-5, or 5-7 bullet points).
  • NEW: Added placement settings (Above Content, After First Paragraph, or Manual Shortcode).
  • NEW: Added Shortcode support [pfd_quick_read].
  • NEW: Added Post Editor sidebar metabox with 1-click “Clear Cache” and “Force Regenerate”.
  • NEW: Added optional “Auto Pre-Generate on Publish/Update” background engine.
  • FIX: Resolved nonce expiry issue that caused 403 errors on heavily cached pages (WP Rocket/LiteSpeed).
  • FIX: Added rate-limiting to protect API quota against bot spam.
  • TWEAK: Tested and certified compatible up to WordPress 6.8+.

1.0.2

  • FIX: Updated default AI model name to gemini-2.5-flash to eliminate API errors.
  • TWEAK: Improved AI prompt to generate concise, high-retention bullet points.

1.0.1

  • FIX: Model endpoint patch.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
